p: Clydebank is a town built on ships. The John Brown yard here launched the Queen Mary, the Queen Elizabeth and the QE2, and the giant Titan Crane still stands on the riverside as a reminder of all that history.

Chalmers Street is right in the middle of things, close to the station and the Clyde Shopping Centre, so it's easy to fit a stop in with a bit of shopping. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's not one for the kids. If you're coming in from Glasgow, trains run regularly, and the town is also a handy jumping-off point towards Loch Lomond and Dumbarton if you fancy heading west for the day.
